title: Unit test: QeMCMC proposal matrix symmetry Q == Q^T
description: Layden 2023 requires |<s'|U|s>| = |<s|U|s'>| for plain Metropolis acceptance; verify for the 8-qubit Trotterized U (palindromic second-order sequence). See docs/research/roadmap-design-notes.md.

title: Size QUBO penalty rho by 256-state enumeration per rebalance date
description: See docs/research/roadmap-design-notes.md. rho_min = max over infeasible x of (F*_feas - F_obj(x))/(sum x - B)^2; use 1.5-2x. Large rho flattens QAOA landscape and shrinks QeMCMC alpha-normalized objective weight.
close_reason: Obsolete after scope change (docs/project-scope.md): XY proposals preserve holding count so no penalty; no out-of-sample backtest in new scope

title: Add classical MCMC baselines (uniform + bit-flip proposals) to QeMCMC comparison
description: Layden 2023 and Marshall 2026 both compare quantum proposals to classical uniform/local proposals at identical T and steps. Without them the quantum-proposal claim is untestable. See docs/research/roadmap-design-notes.md.
